correctness.rationale: Distinguish graph deletion from simplicial deletion: D=del_{N(H_d)}(v)=Y∪Delta(S), intersection the complete d-partite graph Λ on 2d vertices, with g=2d(d-2)+1 cycles. The clique complex of Λ is join of d 2-point sets and simply connected when d>=3; its graph pi1 is normally generated by 3-cycles across distinct parts. The explicit fourth word a⊕b⊕c fills every such triangle in Y, proving Λ→Y nullhomotopic and D≃Y∨g S². The link of v is a cover by N(a)\{v} simplices with singleton pair intersections for different parts, empty same-part and all triple intersections; its nerve is Λ. Triangular nerve loops bound in Y using p_ab,p_bc,p_ca and the same word t, so link→Y is null, yielding a second g S². The independent checker verified local edges, pair/triple intersections d=3,4; intact H1=Z^d and b2 formula come from the separately read older intact-complex theorem, not a new claim.
